mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Federal Reserve Monetary Policy Response to Inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0%) signals an overheating economy, prompting aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in manufacturing production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index) signals an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400.0 (thousands of units) signals weak consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the Fed is expected to cut rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1400.0), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in both retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, prompting the Federal Reserve to adopt an easing stance, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%) consistently signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index) signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
